sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Mobile Utility Software and Device Performance Optimization Apps

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law, French Civil Law, and customary law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus)
No comprehensive Double Tax Agreements currently in force relevant to offshore International Company income

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2002 (Act No. 13 of 2002), as amended, establishing the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit and mandatory customer due diligence; International Companies Act [Cap. 222], as amended, requiring beneficial ownership information to be filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2022; AML/CFT Directions issued under the Financial Dealers (Licensing) Act [Cap. 254]

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of beneficial owner's passport and proof of residential address
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the beneficial owner's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of corporate trust deed, certificate of incorporation, and registry extract (where UBO is a body corporate)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home jurisdiction company registry or notary public

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter from a regulated financial institution confirming account relationship and professional conduct
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the Vanuatu licensed International Service Provider as registered agent

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, shareholders, and authorized signatories must be screened pre-incorporation against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, UK HMT Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions Database, and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit watchlist. PEP status is assessed under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2002, with enhanced due diligence triggered where beneficial ownership exceeds 25% or where PEP exposure arises. Screening evidence must be retained for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Company Name Reservation e-Registry (VFSC Online)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Vanuatu official languages are Bislama, English and French. International Company names must be submitted in Latin script, may be in English, French, or Bislama, and any non-Latin script name will be refused unless transliterated to an acceptable Latin rendering. Names must end with 'Limited', 'Incorporated', 'Corporation', 'Société Anonyme', or an approved abbreviation, and must be distinguishable on the register and not misleading.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be extended for one additional 30-day period if a written extension request is submitted through the licensed registered agent before expiry, accompanied by the applicable VFSC extension fee. If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant may file an administrative appeal with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Appeals Committee within 14 days of the rejection notice, stating the legal and factual grounds and proposing alternative names. The Appeals Committee shall set a hearing within 10 business days. Further recourse lies by judicial review to the Supreme Court of the Republic of Vanuatu.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For ISIC 6201 mobile utility software and device performance optimization applications, a virtual office is permissible because an International Company is not required to maintain physical operational premises in Vanuatu. The statutory registered office is the address of the licensed International Service Provider and may be used for all service of process and statutory correspondence. Freemium revenues through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing do not create a taxable presence or permanent establishment in Vanuatu.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 2-5% annual likelihood for a low-risk remote mobile software company; unannounced inspections are directed primarily at the licensed International Service Provider's premises rather than the underlying International Company.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [CAP 222] (Act No. 32 of 1992), as amended — Sections 3 (tax exemption), 4 (incorporation), 7 (registered agent), 9 (memorandum and articles), and 10 (registration of company); complemented by the International Companies (Fees) Regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Registry, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (VFSC Form) together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association and subscriber statement
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement under ICA [CAP 222]; an International Company may issue one or more shares of par value in any currency, fully or partly paid, and no statutory escrow/paid-up capital account is mandated.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, effective upon the Certificate of Incorporation issued under the International Companies Act [CAP 222]: (1) That the subscriber hereby adopts the Memorandum and Articles of Association as the company's governing constitution. (2) That 100 ordinary shares of USD 0.01 par value each be allotted and issued fully paid in accordance with the share subscription statement. (3) That the registered office be fixed at the office of [Licensed Registered Agent], Port Vila, Vanuatu, and such agent be appointed Registered Agent. (4) That [Name] be and is hereby appointed Director and [Name] appointed Secretary, each to serve until removed by resolution. (5) That the officers be authorized to open bank accounts and execute all filings required to commence operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry, through a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The licensed registered agent submits a written name reservation request to VFSC verifying that the proposed company name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing entity; if cleared, VFSC reserves the name pending formal incorporation.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name ending in Limited, Corporation, Incorporated or equivalent
Name reservation request form
Notarized passport copy of the ultimate beneficial owner
Consent to act as registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as unavailable or misleading, submit a revised reservation with a distinguishing element within 7 days; only a nominal re-filing fee applies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles compliant with ICA [CAP 222] s.9, covering the company name, registered agent and office, authorized share capital, objects, and director/secretary consents; the subscriber executes the documents before an independent witness.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statement of subscriber (name, address, signature)
Consent to act as director and secretary
Consent to act as registered agent
Filing fee remittance slip (USD 250)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a drafting defect is identified, the agent re-executes the amended document and resubmits; substantive inconsistencies only are queried by VFSC, and cure is by revised submission without penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgment of Incorporation Application to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges the Application for Incorporation together with the executed Memorandum and Articles and the KYC dossier; the USD 250 statutory filing fee is paid by electronic transfer or at the VFSC cashier; the application is filed through the VFSC e-portal or physically at the registry counter.
required_dossiers: VFSC Application for Incorporation (signed by registered agent)
Memorandum and Articles of Association
KYC/AML dossier of ultimate beneficial owner including source of funds
Registered agent consent and registered office undertaking
Proof of filing fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query under ICA [CAP 222] s.10, the registered agent files a cure response with corrected documentation within 14 calendar days; failure to respond renders the application deemed withdrawn, requiring a fresh lodgment with a new fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Adoption of First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registrar registers the Memorandum and Articles, enters the company on the International Companies Register, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation; the subscriber then executes the pro-forma first board resolution adopting share subscriptions, the registered office, and officer appointments.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (issued by VFSC)
Register of members, directors and secretary
Executed pro-forma first board resolution
Share subscription statement and allotment entries
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains a typographical error in the name or registration number, a written correction request is filed; the Registrar issues an amended Certificate without charge where the error is apparent on the record.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance and Tax-Exempt Status Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent maintains the statutory registers at the registered office, issues share certificates, and obtains a certified Certificate of Tax Exemption confirming that the International Company, as a non-resident company, is exempt from Vanuatu taxes, including income tax and withholding tax, under ICA [CAP 222] s.3.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Share certificates issued to subscribers
Register of directors, members and charges
VFSC Certificate of Tax Exemption
Registered office verification letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a counterparty bank questions tax-exempt status, request a dedicated VFSC tax status letter; the statutory exemption in ICA s.3 remains conclusive for Vanuatu domestic tax purposes.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no Vanuatu industrial licensing board triggers for pure software development and mobile utility app publishing; commercial activity is confined to cloud-hosted digital products and app store distribution.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no statutory operating or manufacturing permit required for ISIC 6201 software publishing activity under Vanuatu law.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the prescribed activities listed under the Environmental Management and Conservation Act [CAP 283] are not triggered by office-based software development or digital app distribution.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable — zero point-source wastewater or VOC emissions; any negligible e-waste from developer devices must be disposed of through DEPC's solid waste guidance, and cloud hosting emissions fall outside Vanuatu jurisdiction.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No manufacturing premises or physical plant; if a serviced office is leased, the landlord's building occupancy and fire safety certificate must remain in force, and any staff workplace must comply with general occupational health provisions under the Vanuatu Employment Act [CAP 160]; no separate civil defense or structural load license is required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official portal: https://www.customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu; company and International Company registration is administered separately by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) at https://vfsc.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Vanuatu International Company (IC) is not automatically issued a corporate tax identification number because it is treated as fiscally exempt. If the IC makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu or voluntarily registers for VAT, the foreign shareholder(s) must submit a VAT registration application to DCIR through the local registered agent, attaching the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation, the IC tax-exemption certificate, director/shareholder details, registered office and registered agent details, bank account information, app store/operator agreements, and estimated 12-month taxable turnover. DCIR then issues the VAT identification number and VAT registration certificate. For purely offshore mobile app exports with no Vanuatu nexus, no national tax ID is required under standard practice.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Not applicable. Vanuatu has no check-the-box election and no hybrid mismatch election regime. The International Company may elect to obtain and maintain an exemption certificate under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] and remains non-resident and fiscally exempt provided it does not carry on domestic Vanuatu business.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 in annual taxable supplies made in Vanuatu during the preceding 12 months, or expected taxable supplies in the next 12 months; registration is compulsory once the threshold is met.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu has not implemented a real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoice stamping, or government API clearance mandate. Standard VAT tax invoices are required under the VAT Act for taxable supplies; digital app sales discharged through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing may rely on platform sales receipts and settlement reports, but the IC must retain sufficient VAT invoice-level records when claiming zero-rating or input VAT credits.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available for goods physically exported from Vanuatu and for services supplied directly to non-resident recipients who are outside Vanuatu at the time of supply and where the service is not used or consumed in Vanuatu. A mobile utility app sold through Apple App Store or Google Play to non-resident end users or to Apple/Google as non-resident platform resellers qualifies as an export service where the offshore delivery, foreign payment, and non-resident user evidence is fully documented. Domestic sales to Vanuatu residents are taxable at the standard 12.5% VAT rate.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (for physical goods only; not required for pure digital app supplies)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / electronic export manifest (for physical goods only)
Inward Remittance Certificate or payment processor settlement report evidencing foreign currency receipt
Apple App Store Connect and Google Play Console territory sales reports and transaction logs
App distribution agreement with Apple/Google or platform reseller agreement showing offshore recipient status
VFSC International Company registration certificate and tax exemption certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DCIR may scrutinize zero-rating claims, require proof of foreign supply and settlement, and retrospectively claw back VAT refunded in respect of ineligible exports. Fraudulent zero-rating or false refund claims may result in statutory late-payment interest, civil penalties, recovery of unpaid VAT, and criminal prosecution with imprisonment or monetary fines. The IC must retain platform sales evidence, recipient location data, settlement records, and corresponding agreements for the full statutory record-keeping period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) is the competent monetary authority and administrator of the Exchange Control Act (Cap 142); Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) is the licensing and AML/CFT supervisor for International Companies under the International Companies Act (Cap 222).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a liberal, principally convertible exchange-control regime. For licensed International Companies (ICs), both current-account and capital-account transactions are broadly unrestricted: the IC may hold, borrow, and remit foreign currency (USD, EUR, AUD) through domestic licensed banks or offshore accounts without prior RBV approval. The Vatu (VUV) is a small, managed currency with a shallow non-resident market; onshore VUV convertibility is interbank-supported but offshore exchange in VUV is limited, so all international treasury flows should be structurally denominated in USD/EUR/AUD. Profit, dividend, and capital repatriation from an IC is free of exchange-control restriction and, because the IC is tax-exempt under VFSC, there is no withholding tax or profit remittance hurdle.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory surrender or mandatory conversion ratio for export proceeds. A VU_IC may retain 100% of export and SaaS subscription receipts earned from Apple App Store and Google Play in foreign currency, in either on-island foreign-currency accounts or approved offshore accounts, subject only to the standard RBV reporting threshold through the servicing licensed bank. No timeline-based repatriation requirement applies to IC export proceeds.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of the South Pacific (Vanuatu) Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (multi-currency USD, AUD, VUV)
Operational Account (USD/EUR multi-currency, corporate internet banking)
Operational Account (VUV settlement account for local payroll/utilities)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility for a Vanuatu IC. Vanuatu has no dedicated Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licensing regime; offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, Revolut Business) may be used as downstream payment/collection conduits for Apple/Google payout aggregation but must not be represented as licensed banking in Vanuatu. The rigorously correct structure is: (a) a full-service licensed commercial bank in Vanuatu as the primary settlement/treasury account, and (b) a read-only EMI mirror only for converting small inbound app-store residuals where the EMI has passed the VU_IC CDD on a pass-through basis. Legal caution: EMIs that accept deposits without a Vanuatu banking licence could be construed as carrying on deposit-taking business under the Banking Act (Cap 54) if they market to Vanuatu residents; keep all EMI activity offshore, non-advertised, and non-resident-facing.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Most tier-1 Vanuatu banks mandate a face-to-face or live two-way video KYC interview for directors and beneficial owners of an International Company. Physical attendance in Port Vila is required for first-time third-country nationals unless the bank accepts an approved registered-agent certification path; in practical onboarding, the directors of VU_IC should appear via bank-grade video call with the VFSC-licensed registered agent co-present, followed by notarised passport pages, banker's reference, and original corporate documents couriered to the bank's compliance team.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt non-resident International Company with offshore directors and fragmented app-store revenue from Apple and Google
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of incorporation and good-standing from VFSC; register of directors and shareholders; registered-agent introduction letter; UBO declaration with passport and proof-of-residence; Apple Developer Programme and Google Play Console legal-entity verification pages; 6-month payout statements; detailed transaction flow chart; board resolution appointing bank signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid disbursement pattern to overseas contractors and FX counterparties inconsistent with a small software app
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed software development and SaaS licensing contracts; itemised contractor invoices; IP assignment agreements; reference checks from prior banking relationships; monthly management accounts; forecast cash-flow model; declaration of economic substance and Principal Place of Business addressing VFSC expectations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Potential shell-company indicators: no local payroll, no physical office, low asset base in an offshore jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial substance file containing the mobile utility app source-code repository ownership, app analytics dashboards, Google Play/Apple revenue-share reports, registered-agent service agreement, and a letter from the Vanuatu IC's compliance officer describing the real global user base and operational strategy.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital injection must be routed via SWIFT MT103 to the VU_IC's licensed-bank account in Port Vila using purpose code 'IC capital contribution / equity subscription' on the RBV Exchange Control declaration; the bank will tag the credit as capital and hold it in the Capital Escrow Account pending verification of the corporate registry excerpt and the UBO declaration. The instruction must include reference to the VU_IC registration number and the commercial bank's VFSC-approved KYC file; no physical FX conversion into VUV is required since the capital stays in USD/EUR. For Apple/Google IAP proceeds, the payout rails arrive directly from Apple Distribution International (Ireland) and Google Payment Corp (Luxembourg/US) as commercial ordinary revenue under the purpose code 'software licence royalty / digital services', and banks will verify those with the developer payout statements rather than invoices.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements are cleared through SWIFT MT103 for contractor service fees and app-store infrastructure charges; SWIFT MT700 (documentary Commercial Letter of Credit) for any major equipment/licensed software procurement; SHA/OUR charges guidance; all outbound remittances require the standard RBV Form-E zero-reporting line and bank AML screen for the beneficiary. If disbursements exceed USD 50,000 monthly, the servicing bank may request a treasury forecast and matching disbursement schedule; the recommended rail is a single USD concentration account in Vanuatu sweeping to a USD account at a US correspondent bank for USD-denominated contractor payments, thereby avoiding VUV FX drag.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore full-deliverable USD/VUV forward contracts via licensed commercial banks (limited tenor, real-economy hedging documentation required)
Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) referencing USD/VUV with major counterparty banks, permitted only as a hedge against forecast USD app-store receipts converted to VUV local costs
Cross-currency swap (USD against AUD/EUR) booked with an approved Vanuatu bank to match Apple/Google payouts in the payout currency against contractor liabilities
Natural hedging through multi-currency accounts (USD, EUR, AUD) maintaining matched asset-liability books without conversion
Plain vanilla FX option (US-style) over-the-counter, on exercise-authorised onshore banking counterparty, for down-side protection on VUV operating-cost conversion

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: VFSC Annual License Fee Renewal and Registered Agent Annual Compliance Return (functional equivalent of the annual return for a Vanuatu International Company)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — lodged exclusively through a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Each anniversary of the date of incorporation; administrative grace period expires at the close of the calendar month in which the anniversary falls
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of 20% of the unpaid annual license fee; continued non-payment for 3 months after the anniversary triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution by the Registrar under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], extinguishing legal capacity and exposing directors and shareholders to personal liability for post-dissolution dealings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation of Directors, Members, Shareholders, and Beneficial Owners (UBO Confirmation Certificate maintained in the statutory registers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent acting under the AML/CFT Act 2014; records remain at the registered office and are produced to the VFSC on demand
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with the annual license fee on each incorporation anniversary; any intra-year change in shareholding or beneficial ownership must be reported to the agent within 21 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deliver an accurate confirmation prevents the agent from issuing the VFSC annual compliance attestation; knowingly false or omitted UBO data constitutes an offense punishable by director disqualification and fines; continued non-compliance enables the agent to resign, leading to loss of registered office and administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Consent to Continue as Registered Agent and Registered Office (renewed agency mandate and annual continuity notice)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC via the Licensed Registered Agent; any change of agent must be notified within 21 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation for renewal of mandate; 21 days from any change of registered agent or registered office address
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Termination without replacement removes the mandatory Vanuatu registered office, leaving the company without legal service capacity; the VFSC may strike off the company after issuance of an administrative notice under Section 215 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Vanuatu International Companies are statutorily exempt from independent audit, financial statement preparation, and account filing with any registry. A compulsory audit is triggered only where the entity holds a separate VFSC regulatory license under the International Banking Act, International Insurance Act, or Dealers in Securities Act, in which case audited financial statements must be submitted to the relevant regulator annually.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework is prescribed for unlicensed International Companies; voluntary financial statements may be prepared under IFRS (the default standard in Vanuatu professional practice) or acceptable local GAAP. Such statements need not be published or delivered to the VFSC.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: On each anniversary, the Licensed Registered Agent must obtain and verify a written confirmation of the company's current beneficial ownership against its KYC file. Every transfer of shares or change of directors or ultimate beneficial owners occurring during the year must be reported to the agent within 21 days, with the Register of Members updated and the beneficial ownership register amended concurrently. The agent retains the certified confirmation and underlying due-diligence documents in accordance with the AML/CFT Act 2014 and makes them available to the VFSC for inspection without prior company consent.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of General Meetings and Resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 – 1,200 per annum for a VFSC-licensed registered agent covering registered office, annual license processing, KYC/UBO administration, and regulatory correspondence; premium compliance-managed agents typically charge USD 1,500 – 2,000 including virtual office support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 for the standard tax-exempt International Company because no statutory audit is required; a voluntary certified audit, when commissioned for investor, banking-counterparty, or acquirer due diligence, generally ranges from USD 2,500 to 5,200 depending on transaction volume and books complexity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax; International Companies are expressly exempt from income tax on all profits under the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero effective CIT on offshore business income; no capital gains tax, no personal income tax, no estate or inheritance tax, and no stamp duty on share transfers. The 12.5% Value Added Tax (VAT) applies only to taxable supplies of goods and services made in Vanuatu and does not attach to offshore app-store revenue earned through Apple IAP or Google Play Billing.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists for International Companies. The sole annual compliance instrument is the VFSC Annual Return (prescribed form under Section 92 of the International Companies Act), submitted through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) electronic filing portal via the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Return and the annual license fee are due on or within one month after each anniversary of the company's registration date. Non-payment generates a late penalty of 10% of the annual fee; the company becomes liable to strike-off if the fee remains unpaid for three months after the due date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered name, registration number, date of incorporation, and details of the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the exact name shown on the Certificate of Incorporation; confirm the registered agent as the statutory point of contact with VFSC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical registered office address in Vanuatu maintained by the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A physical Vanuatu address is mandatory; a post office box alone is not acceptable. Offshore directors may rely on the agent's address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, nationalities, residential addresses, and shareholding particulars of directors and ultimate beneficial owners.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident individuals and corporate shareholders are fully permitted; all nominee arrangements must be disclosed to the registered agent for AML record-keeping.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part 4 — Compliance and Tax Status Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the company has not carried on local business in Vanuatu and that no Vanuatu-sourced taxable supplies were made during the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a mobile utility app deriving revenue solely through foreign app-store channels, declare zero Vanuatu-sourced activity. Any local Vanuatu business activity would void the IC tax exemption and trigger domestic tax exposure.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Regulatory late filing fee of 10% of the annual license fee; automatic accrual of arrears; liability to strike-off from the Register where the annual fee remains unpaid for three months; reinstatement costs and VFSC restoration fees for struck-off companies; persistent default may lead to director disqualification and restriction on using Vanuatu corporate services.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax, no tax on distributions by International Companies, and no branch remittance tax or exit charge on profit repatriation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Treaty relief is practically inapplicable: Vanuatu maintains no substantive comprehensive double taxation agreement network, only tax information exchange agreements and limited bilateral arrangements. Where a Certificate of Tax Residence is required by a foreign revenue authority, application is made to VFSC through the registered agent, supported by the IC's incorporation certificate and compliance history. Because the domestic corporate tax rate is 0%, dividend treaty relief is moot for Vanuatu-sourced income; foreign-source app-store revenue is instead subject to the tax rules of the platform payment processor's jurisdiction (e.g., U.S. federal withholding considerations).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic withholding tax on cross-border royalties and debt interest: 0% (no such withholding taxes are imposed under Vanuatu law). Treaty rates: no applicable reduced treaty rates exist due to the absence of a comprehensive DTA network; foreign withholding taxes on royalties or interest paid by the Vanuatu entity will be governed solely by the payer's residence state and local law.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer pricing documentation regime exists in Vanuatu. International Companies are not required to prepare Local File, Master File, or Country-by-Country reporting in Vatu or any other currency, and no monetary threshold triggers such obligations. Arm's length principles are not codified for ICs under domestic tax law.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu's Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) impose substance and annual reporting obligations only on undertakings performing relevant activities: banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, holding company, intellectual property holding, and distribution and service centers. A mobile utility software developer earning fee-based revenue from app-store sales is not a relevant activity and is therefore outside ESR filing scope. However, if the legal structure segregates the app's intellectual property into a separate IP-holding company or derives royalty income from the IP, an ESR return becomes mandatory, requiring local board meetings, local management decisions, adequate staff, and expenditure proportionate to the IP activity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the International Company to carry on local Vanuatu trade or business, such as on-island sales of the app to Vanuatu residents, local advertising contracts, domestic office leasing, or any Vanuatu-sourced service revenue.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Forfeiture of the tax-exempt status; the IC is legally prohibited from engaging in local business; VFSC may strike the company off the Register and impose monetary penalties on the company and every officer in default.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for the company's regulatory defaults, subject to fines, restitution orders, and disqualification from acting as directors of any Vanuatu company for a prescribed period.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing Vanuatu-sourced revenue, misclassifying local taxable supplies as offshore income, failing to register for and remit the 12.5% Value Added Tax on domestic supplies, or submitting false declarations to VFSC to preserve the offshore exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil assessment of unpaid tax, interest accrual, and statutory penalties of up to 200% of the tax evaded; criminal prosecution for tax evasion; compulsory deregistration of the company and its exclusion from the IC regime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Criminal conviction of directors and officers who knowingly assist evasion, carrying terms of imprisonment, personal financial penalties, travel bans pending prosecution, and direct civil liability for remitted tax, notwithstanding the corporate veil.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Sham Substance Structure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC with nominee-only governance, no commercial activities, no bank account in the company's own name, and no economic substance, while using the entity to channel app-store or IP royalty revenue in a manner that misleads foreign tax authorities or conceals beneficial ownership.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off and refusal of restoration by VFSC; adverse regulatory findings impeding any future Vanuatu corporate registration; activation of international exchange of information mechanisms (tax information exchange agreements and the Global Forum standard) that expose the structure to foreign revenue authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil restitution of diverted assets, disqualification orders against directors, personal exposure to foreign tax assessments where the sham is treated as the taxpayer's alter ego, and criminal liability if the structure is used to commit fraud or money laundering.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering and Beneficial Ownership Default
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to disclose or deliberately misstating the ultimate beneficial owner to the registered agent, maintaining false or incomplete shareholder registers, or using undisclosed third-party payout accounts in the App Store Connect or Google Play payment flows to obscure the economic beneficiary.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Regulatory fines imposed under the VFSC supervisory framework, suspension or resignation of the registered agent, and eventual compulsory strike-off for non-compliance with beneficial ownership information requirements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines and imprisonment for knowingly furnishing false beneficial ownership information; directors face disqualification, personal liability for the company's regulatory costs, and cannot rely on corporate legal form to defeat AML enforcement.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Manipulation in Foreign Group Structures
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu tax-exempt entity as a pricing hub to book inflated IP royalties or service fees from related sellers in high-tax jurisdictions while maintaining no real development activity or management function in Vanuatu, thereby eroding the foreign group's taxable profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu imposes no domestic transfer pricing penalty, but foreign revenue authorities may recharacterize the arrangement, impose transfer pricing adjustments, apply withholding tax gross-ups, and request information from Vanuatu through international exchange mechanisms, triggering follow-on civil penalties in the foreign jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of the foreign parent company face personal liability for fraudulent transfer pricing adjustments in the residence state; directors of the Vanuatu IC face regulatory reprimand, cooperation obligations under information exchange requests, and possible disqualification for facilitating an economic substance sham.
